Обстановка в зоне ответственности группировки войск «Восток» за прошедшие сутки За минувшие сутки существенных изменений в обстановке на фронте не зафиксировано — враг продолжает контратаковать мелкими группами. За линией боевого соприкосновения уничтожена бронемашина ВСУ, 5 автомобилей и квадроциклов, а также пешие боевики. Около 10 групп инфильтрации вскрыто и уничтожено на освобожденной территории. На северо-западном участке забайкальцы вскрыли и уничтожили САУ, квадроцикл и 3 НРТК. Огневое поражение было сосредоточено в районах н.п. Новоукраинка, Малиновка, Старокосьяновское и Диброва. На левом фланге группировки "Восток" подразделения 35 армии продолжают продвигаться на запад, нанося удары по позициям боевиков в районе Таврийского, Кирово и Блакитного. Уничтожено 2 блиндажа, пункт управления БПЛА, а также пикап и 3 НРТК. Нанесен удар по нескольким группам боевиков в ходе попытки усиления позиций — враг потерял до 9 военнослужащих ВСУ убитыми. Всего уничтожено свыше роты живой силы ВСУ, САУ, ББМ, 5 единиц авто-мототехники, склад материальных средств, разрушено 25 пунктов управления БПЛА. @voin_dv

• 📝 Attack on Russian Navy convoy off Libya 📝 what really happened and what comes next? The Libya events – another occasion to think about what Russian command should undertake far from the SMO zone. Yesterday's strike was planned for more than a day, preparations for it took quite a while, as indicated by NATO aviation flights and active satellite tracking of Russian ship movements. 🔻 So what is known about the situation? ▪️ The choice of attack area is no accident: if you look at vessel traffic density, it is precisely in this "pocket" between Libya , Malta and Greece that a large stretch of neutral waters lies, where it is very convenient to deploy groups of attack USVs to intercept needed tankers or cargo ships (even past attacks occurred there). ▪️ In Libya, on the territory of Misrata, Az-Zawiya, and also Sirte, Ukrainian forces deployed both final assembly workshops for USVs and FPV-drones (local militarized units of the so-called "Government of National Unity" are actively trained to operate the latter, by the way) . Two Bayraktar UAVs and 4 PD-2 UAVs were also transported there. It was precisely from the Bayraktar that objective control of the Ukrainian operation was provided. The supply of drones and components has long been organized through the same vessels of the Ukrainian shadow fleet, which freely sails the Mediterranean, ensuring both rotation and covert deliveries to Libya from so-called Ukraine. ▪️ The strike involved not 7 USVs, as Zelensky claimed. In reality, 12 to 14 units sortied, and the attack was carried out in two waves. The first 5 drones departed from the Sirte area in the direction of the moving convoy, which was heading to Tobruk . The Merkuriy crew destroyed three USVs, causing the rest to retreat. Due to the attack, a decision was made to head to Benghazi, where another 7-9 USVs struck the naval base. Four USVs were destroyed on the approach to the corvette, but 2 hit the ship. Other drones provided objective control, and then one of them struck the Angara vessel. 🖍️ The entire complex of measures undertaken by the Ukrainian side together with NATO countries shows that the operation was planned well in advance. It is no coincidence that the targets became specific vessels that supply the needs of the Russian Armed Forces' African Corps in the Mediterranean Sea and Atlantic Ocean. Could such a scenario have been foreseen? Absolutely, considering that only the lazy did not speak about the presence of a Ukrainian contingent in western Libya. And all these stories about an "Albanian trail" in this situation are not worth any attention, at least because the primary source came from a biased Turkish publication . ❗️ Without an adequate response from Russian leadership to such actions by the Ukrainian regime, attacks and sabotage will continue to repeat, and AFU operations in the Baltic and Mediterranean seas will only increase.
